en: The Apadāna of the Elder Kuṭidāyaka Thomakavagga 9 I gave a hut to the Buddha, the Teacher, who was accompanied by his retinue; because of that deed, I have attained the fruit of Stream-entry. I am now a Stream-enterer, no longer subject to rebirth in the lower realms. Having reached the certainty of enlightenment, I shall proceed toward Nibbāna. This is my final birth; there will be no further existence for me. I have transcended all suffering; I am now free from all bonds. I have reached the end of the cycle of rebirth; I have attained the state of peace. I have crossed over the ocean of saṃsāra; I have reached the further shore. I have attained the supreme security from bondage; I have realized the goal of the holy life. I have become one who has done what was to be done; I am a Worthy One (Arhat). I have attained the fruit of Arhatship; I am cool and at peace. I have reached the end of the journey; I have laid down the burden. My own welfare is accomplished; the holy life has been lived. There is no more of this state of being; I have reached the end of birth. I have attained the destruction of craving; I have realized the state of non-returning. I have reached the end of the world; I have attained the state of peace. I have attained the supreme state; I have reached the end of suffering. I have reached the end of the cycle of rebirth; I have attained the state of liberation. I have reached the end of the ocean of existence; I have attained the state of Nibbāna. I have reached the end of the path of defilements; I have attained the state of purity. I have reached the end of the cycle of becoming; I have attained the state of cessation. I have reached the end of the cycle of birth; I have attained the state of deathlessness. I have reached the end of the cycle of old age; I have attained the state of youthfulness. I have reached the end of the cycle of disease; I have attained the state of health. I have reached the end of the cycle of sorrow; I have attained the state of joy.

I have reached the end of the cycle of lamentation; I have attained the state of tranquility. I have reached the end of the cycle of pain; I have attained the state of bliss. I have reached the end of the cycle of despair; I have attained the state of happiness. I have reached the end of the cycle of fear; I have attained the state of fearlessness. I have reached the end of the cycle of doubt; I have attained the state of certainty. I have reached the end of the cycle of delusion; I have attained the state of wisdom. I have reached the end of the cycle of ignorance; I have attained the state of knowledge. I have reached the end of the cycle of blindness; I have attained the state of vision. I have reached the end of the cycle of obstruction; I have attained the state of clarity. I have reached the end of the cycle of confinement; I have attained the state of freedom. I have reached the end of the cycle of bondage; I have attained the state of liberation. I have reached the end of the cycle of attachment; I have attained the state of detachment. I have reached the end of the cycle of clinging; I have attained the state of non-clinging. I have reached the end of the cycle of grasping; I have attained the state of non-grasping. I have reached the end of the cycle of desire; I have attained the state of desirelessness. I have reached the end of the cycle of passion; I have attained the state of dispassion. I have reached the end of the cycle of lust; I have attained the state of lustlessness. I have reached the end of the cycle of craving; I have attained the state of craving-cessation. I have reached the end of the cycle of thirst; I have attained the state of thirst-quenching. I have reached the end of the cycle of hunger; I have attained the state of satiety. I have reached the end of the cycle of greed; I have attained the state of contentment. I have reached the end of the cycle of avarice; I have attained the state of generosity. I have reached the end of the cycle of stinginess; I have attained the state of magnanimity. I have reached the end of the cycle of miserliness; I have attained the state of nobility. I have reached the end of the cycle of envy; I have attained the state of equanimity. I have reached the end of the cycle of jealousy; I have attained the state of impartiality. I have reached the end of the cycle of partiality; I have attained the state of universality. I have reached the end of the cycle of bias; I have attained the state of balance. I have reached the end of the cycle of imbalance; I have attained the state of harmony. I have reached the end of the cycle of discord; I have attained the state of concord. I have reached the end of the cycle of conflict; I have attained the state of peace. I have reached the end of the cycle of strife; I have attained the state of non-strife. I have reached the end of the cycle of violence; I have attained the state of non-violence. I have reached the end of the cycle of harm; I have attained the state of harmlessness. I have reached the end of the cycle of injury; I have attained the state of non-injury. I have reached the end of the cycle of suffering; I have attained the state of non-suffering. I have reached the end of the cycle of pain; I have attained the state of non-pain. I have reached the end of the cycle of distress; I have attained the state of non-distress. I have reached the end of the cycle of affliction; I have attained the state of non-affliction. I have reached the end of the cycle of turmoil; I have attained the state of non-turmoil. I have reached the end of the cycle of agitation; I have attained the state of non-agitation. I have reached the end of the cycle of restlessness; I have attained the state of non-restlessness. I have reached the end of the cycle of instability; I have attained the state of stability. I have reached the end of the cycle of wavering; I have attained the state of steadfastness. I have reached the end of the cycle of fluctuation; I have attained the state of immovability. I have reached the end of the cycle of change; I have attained the state of unchangeability. I have reached the end of the cycle of transformation; I have attained the state of non-transformation. I have reached the end of the cycle of evolution; I have attained the state of non-evolution. I have reached the end of the cycle of development; I have attained the state of non-development. I have reached the end of the cycle of growth; I have attained the state of non-growth. I have reached the end of the cycle of increase; I have attained the state of non-increase. I have reached the end of the cycle of expansion; I have attained the state of non-expansion. I have reached the end of the cycle of extension; I have attained the state of non-extension. I have reached the end of the cycle of breadth; I have attained the state of non-breadth. I have reached the end of the cycle of width; I have attained the state of non-width. I have reached the end of the cycle of magnitude; I have attained the state of non-magnitude. I have reached the end of the cycle of greatness; I have attained the state of non-greatness. I have reached the end of the cycle of smallness; I have attained the state of non-smallness. I have reached the end of the cycle of minuteness; I have attained the state of non-minuteness.

I have reached the end of the cycle of subtlety; I have attained the state of non-subtlety. I have reached the end of the cycle of fineness; I have attained the state of non-fineness. I have reached the end of the cycle of delicacy; I have attained the state of non-delicacy. I have reached the end of the cycle of softness; I have attained the state of non-softness. I have reached the end of the cycle of hardness; I have attained the state of non-hardness. I have reached the end of the cycle of rigidity; I have attained the state of non-rigidity. I have reached the end of the cycle of stiffness; I have attained the state of non-stiffness. I have reached the end of the cycle of inflexibility; I have attained the state of flexibility. I have reached the end of the cycle of inflexibility; I have attained the state of adaptability. I have reached the end of the cycle of resistance; I have attained the state of non-resistance. I have reached the end of the cycle of opposition; I have attained the state of non-opposition. I have reached the end of the cycle of contradiction; I have attained the state of non-contradiction. I have reached the end of the cycle of conflict; I have attained the state of non-conflict. I have reached the end of the cycle of dispute; I have attained the state of non-dispute. I have reached the end of the cycle of contention; I have attained the state of non-contention. I have reached the end of the cycle of strife; I have attained the state
“The Fully Awakened One, wandering in the forest,
was then dwelling at the foot of a tree;
having constructed a leaf-hut, he remained there.”
I do not know a state of woe;
this is the fruit of giving a hut.
they were called "Universal Monarchs" because it rained everywhere.
[and so on] ...the Buddha’s teaching has been accomplished.
Thus indeed the venerable elder Kuṭidāyaka spoke these verses.
This is the ninth legend of the elder Kuṭidāyaka.
